subject: Elin
fact: Elin is a 7-year-old girl who has been silent for six days, draws a six-pointed star on every flat surface in her environment, and speaks only in her sleep — her utterance being 'The wells are not wells anymore.'
source_quote: She says it is only the shape that holds.

subject: Maerith of the Ford
fact: Maerith is Elin’s mother, exhausted from seeking help at every temple and institution, and has repeatedly been turned away — she noticed the dragon-and-scale holy symbol as the usual trigger for hope.
source_quote: She spotted my holy symbol during dinner, which is the usual trigger.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a meticulous observer with a precise mind, who noticed subtle environmental and perceptual anomalies others dismissed — including a growing pressure in his own head.
source_quote: Daz mentioned the pressure in his own head — had been mentioning it, in various indirect ways, for a while now.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir identified the mechanism of Elin’s condition as a perceptual distortion — the world is arriving as corrupted audio input she cannot process, not as magic or disease.
source_quote: The input, the audio, the way the world was arriving at her rather than the world itself.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sentient sword with strong opinions on timing and intervention; it initiated Lesser Restoration on Elin, which enabled her first coherent speech.
source_quote: Let me bring the light to you.

subject: The Underdark’s Structural Wrongness
fact: An emergent, non-magical corruption originating beneath the Underdark is bleeding upward, disrupting perception and reality processing in those it touches — manifesting as auditory hallucinations and symbolic withdrawal.
source_quote: The madness from the Underdark — the deep, structural wrongness we'd felt building around the demon lords... was not, apparently, staying below.

subject: The Temples
fact: The temples have been unable to diagnose or treat Elin’s condition, reflecting their institutional limitations against non-magical, non-infectious perceptual corruption.

subject: Lesser Restoration on Elin
fact: A Lesser Restoration spell cast by Dawnbringer cleared enough mental interference for Elin to speak one coherent sentence — 'The wells are not wells anymore.'
source_quote: And then she spoke. 'The wells are not wells anymore.'

subject: Perceptual Distortion Diagnosis
fact: The party concluded that Elin’s condition is not a disease, infection, or magical effect, but a perceptual failure — the world is transmitting corrupted signals she cannot interpret, resulting in silence and symbolic repetition.
source_quote: It wasn't a disease in the conventional sense. It was more like the world had started speaking a language she couldn't process.

subject: Six-pointed star drawings
fact: Elin’s repeated drawings of a six-pointed star on every flat surface are not random — they are an attempt to externalize and stabilize an internal perceptual collapse.
source_quote: She draws the same shape on every flat surface.

subject: The Wells Are Not Wells Anymore
fact: Elin’s utterance is a cryptic revelation pointing to a fundamental distortion in reality — 'wells' may symbolize sources of perception, truth, or connection that have been corrupted or replaced.
source_quote: The wells are not wells anymore.

subject: The Pressure in Daz’s Head
fact: Daz’s unacknowledged head pressure suggests he is experiencing the same perceptual bleed as Elin — a sign the corruption is spreading and may be active in others.
source_quote: I looked at him. I looked at Elin. I thought about what we'd just established.

subject: The Bleeding Underdark
fact: The structural wrongness from beneath is not contained — it is rising, affecting perception across the surface world, and may be the root cause of recent phenomena in Neverlight Grove, the Pudding King’s court, and now Elin.
source_quote: It was reaching up. It was reaching Elin.

subject: Session Date
fact: The events occurred during a single night of medical and metaphysical inquiry — the culmination of failed temple visits, failed examinations, and a final revelation.
source_quote: Twenty-three. My best of the evening, arriving too late to be medically useful and just in time to be philosophically concerning.
